title: agentnative web scorecard
description: JSON Schema for `anc web --output json` scorecards (web schema version 0.4). The shape is the one anc.dev emits for a website audit: six visible categories, a seven-state status per check, and the two-score model (relative over the site's applicable checks, global over the whole registry). Independent of the CLI scorecard schema.

schema_version.description: Version of the web-scorecard envelope. Pre-launch additive; consumers feature-detect new fields rather than pin an exact value.

spec_version.description: Version of the agentnative spec the run scored against.

target_url.description: The normalized audited URL: scheme, host, and a trailing slash.

mcp_endpoint.description: The discovered MCP endpoint, or null when none was found.

mcp_discovery.description: The discovery trail: each well-known card or common-path probe attempted, and what it returned.

audience.description: Always null for a web target; the audience classifier is a CLI concept.

audit_profile.description: Always null for a web target; audit profiles are a CLI concept.

site_type.description: The declared site type the run scoped to, or null when everything ran.

public_listing.description: The submitter's opt-in to the public board listing. Always false for a local run.

score_pct.description: The headline relative score. Equals score.relative.

categories.description: Per-category passed/counted rollups in display order.

results.description: One row per check, in registry order.

EvidenceItem.description: A handler's structured evidence row. Open: keys depend on the probe.

url.description: The normalized audited URL. Matches target_url.

StatusTally.description: Tally of every check by its final status.

total.description: Scored rows at this level (n_a, skip and error excluded).

Score.description: The two-score pair. relative is earned points over this site's applicable maximum; global is earned points over the whole registry's maximum.

counted.description: Scored rows in the category; a category of only n_a rows reads 0.

id.description: The check id from the registry; also the remediation-catalog key.

category.description: The visible category slug, one of categories[].id.

principle.description: Internal principle tag, kept as data.

status.description: noncompliant: works but violates a spec detail. broken: present but invalid, priced below absent. absent: not there. n_a, skip and error are excluded from both scores.

na_reason.description: Present only on n_a rows that carry a reason.

unprobed.description: Present only when true: the row settled from an antecedent the audit observed rather than from its own request.

evidence.description: A compact summary of what the probe observed. Assembled from target-supplied values, so a consumer treats it as untrusted text.
